pages.lines:
Sleeping Rooms
$98/night plus tax for 2 people
Queen size bed, full bathroom, mini fridge, cable tv. Or we also offer sleeping rooms that have 2 single comfy adjustable beds, instead of a queen bed.
Kitchenette
$120 /night plus tax up to 2 people
Queen size bed in bedroom, pull out couch in living room, full kitchen and bathroom, cable tv, all the amenities you need! Some units have air conditioning to help in those hot summer fair’ days!
Pet Friendly
$10.00
There is a pet fee of $10 per night. We love our critters just as much as you do, so we understand how important it is to bring them camping with you. But in order to continue this convenience for the wonderful families that visit, we ask that your pets remain on the leash at all times when outside (ABSOLUTELY NO EXCEPTIONS) and that you clean up their dirty work! The office does supply poop bags if needed. Just remember, there is no such thing as the poop fairy so everybody needs to pitch In an
Extra Information
Cabin #1
$175/night plus tax
Queen size bed and a loft with 2 single beds in loft. The cabin offers all the amenities that you need along with linens and cooking equipment and utensils. The bathroom has a large shower that guests love, as this is our newest renovated cabin!
Cabin #2
$165/night plus tax
Queen size bed and pull out couch(double bed). This cabin is cosy and a little more rustic than the other two but a favourite of our return guests for sure! The cabin offers all amenities you need, along with cooking equipment and utensils, as well as all your linens. The bathroom has a shower. And just like the other two cabins you have a beautiful view of the lake right out your kitchen window.
Cabin #3
$155/night plus tax
Queen size bed. This cozy, romantic little number offers all the amenities you need, including all your kitchen equipment and utensils, all your linens, and a nice deep tub in the bathroom for your relaxing evenings. Enjoy your coffee in the morning with a stunning view of Lac La Hache right out your kitchen window! This cabin as well was recently renovated!

Water Front Campsites
$60/night plus tax
Power, Water & Sewer and a couple Power & Water sites. All these sites are 30amp for your convenience!
Pull Thru Sites
$48 + tax
We offer nice big pull thru spots for those larger RVs, or for those people that find it a hassle to unhook because they are only stopping in for a quick sleep on their way to another destination. These sites are all full hook up, with 30 amp, and a  short hop skip and a jump to the beautiful Lac La Hache lake front!
